pkgmetadata.longdescription: Frontend for the wallpaper backends swaybg, swww, awww, wallutils, hyprpaper, mpvpaper, gslapper, xwallpaper, feh and linux-wallpaperengine, presenting the images of a chosen directory as a thumbnail grid. GIF animations, videos and per-monitor wallpapers work with the backends that support them; waypaper --restore reapplies the last choice at login.
